methodology.Fees: Total swap fees paid by traders — each pool's fee rate applied to its swap volume.
methodology.Revenue: The 20% share of swap fees the protocol keeps and sends to the Ref DAO treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The 20% treasury cut of swap fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The 80% of swap fees earned by liquidity providers.
methodology.Volume: Sum of 24h swap volume across all Ref/Rhea pools on NEAR (classic, stable, rated and concentrated-liquidity), skipping any pool whose 24h volume exceeds 15x its liquidity as likely wash trading.

Value of tokens sent through the Allbridge Classic bridge, counted once on the source chain at the amount bridged after the fee. Transfers sent from Solana, Near and Stellar are not tracked since 2026-08-31.
methodology.Fees: Bridge fee users pay in the transferred token on each send from the source chain. Sends from Solana, Near and Stellar are not tracked since 2026-08-31.
methodology.Revenue: 20% of the bridge fees collected on sends, kept by the protocol.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Protocol receives 20% of the collected bridge fee.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 80% of the collected bridge fee is used for rewards to the stakers

Fees.Bridge Fees: Fees charged to users for each cross-chain token transfer on the source chain.

Revenue.Bridge Fees: 20% of bridge fees kept by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Bridge Fees: 20% of bridge fees collected by the protocol treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Bridge Fees: 80% of bridge fees distributed as rewards to stakers who provide liquidity.

methodology.Revenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of interest going to treasury

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by traders on VEAX pools, at the 0.01% to 1.28% rate of each liquidity fee level a swap trades through.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees paid by traders on VEAX pools. Each pool has eight liquidity fee levels from 0.01% to 1.28%, and a swap pays the rate of every level it trades through. Excludes swaps that have no wNEAR, stablecoin, ETH, BTC or stNEAR side, and the 2026-10-31 exploit.
methodology.Revenue: Share of swap fees kept by the VEAX protocol: 20% since 2025-05-20, 0.01% before.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Share of swap fees accrued to the VEAX protocol inside the veax.near contract: 20% since 2025-05-20, 0.01% before.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Share of swap fees earned by VEAX liquidity providers: 80% since 2025-05-20, 99.99% before.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, at the rate of each liquidity fee level (0.01% to 1.28%) a swap trades through.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by traders, at the rate of each liquidity fee level (0.01% to 1.28%) a swap trades through.

Revenue.Protocol Fees: Protocol share of swap fees: 20% since 2025-05-20, 0.01% before.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: Protocol share of swap fees, accrued inside the veax.near contract: 20% since 2025-05-20, 0.01% before.

SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees: Liquidity provider share of swap fees: 80% since 2025-05-20, 99.99% before.

methodology.Volume: All deposits and withdrawals into currently ongoing auctions
methodology.Fees: Fees from deposits (0.5%), withdrawals (2%) and launch fee (2%)
methodology.Revenue: All fees from deposits and launch fees are for the protocol
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: There is a 2% withdrawal fee, which gets redistributed to all depositors of the same auction and referrals (shares 50% of deposit fee)

methodology.Fees: Estimated daily management fees from KAIO's current TVL and the annual fund fee rates listed on RWA.xyz.
methodology.Revenue: Management fees are counted as protocol revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All estimated management fee revenue is attributed to the protocol.

Fees.Management Fees: Estimated management fees from KAIO's current TVL and the annual fund fee rates listed on RWA.xyz.

Revenue.Management Fees: Management fees are counted as protocol revenue.

ProtocolRevenue.Management Fees: All estimated management fee revenue is attributed to the protocol.

methodology.Fees: Gross fees charged on NEAR Intents swaps - the protocol fee plus the affiliate (distribution) fee each frontend collects, summed across all integrators.
methodology.Revenue: NEAR's net captured revenue, measured as NEAR/wNEAR swept into its revenue wallets (reconciles with revenue.near.org and the on-chain buyback). Split by destination wallet into front-end affiliate revenue and Other. Transfers between those wallets are excluded.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Captured revenue held by the treasury before the 2026-02-23 buyback program.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Since 2026-02-23, NEAR's captured Intents revenue is used to buy back $NEAR on the open market (not burned), returning value to holders.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Gross fees minus NEAR's captured revenue - the affiliate fees kept by solvers and third-party distribution channels (e.g. SwapKit).

Fees.Swap Fees: Gross protocol + affiliate fees charged on NEAR Intents swaps across all integrators.

Revenue.Front-end Affiliate Revenue: Revenue collected by NEAR's front-end fund wallet (near.com / app.near-intents.org).
Revenue.Other Revenue: All other captured revenue: 1Click and partner revenue shares, quote improvement (positive slippage), private agreements, and buyback-wallet flows.

ProtocolRevenue.NEAR Treasury: Captured revenue retained by the treasury before the 2026-02-23 buyback program.

HoldersRevenue.NEAR Buyback: $NEAR bought back on the open market with captured Intents revenue, from 2026-02-23 onward.

SupplySideRevenue.Fees To Solvers & Distribution Channels: Gross fees less NEAR's captured share - kept by solvers and third-party distribution channels.

methodology.Fees: Total yield generated by the sAID vault portfolio (AI infrastructure financing + T-bills). Measured as the increase in vault totalAssets over the period.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol spread — GAIB retains ~20% of gross yield, computed as the difference between gross and net APR paid to sAID holders. Actual rates vary over time and are derived from current vault metrics.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The net yield earned by AID stakers

methodology.UserFees: Percentage of rewards paid to protocol
methodology.Revenue: Percentage of user rewards paid to protocol

methodology.Volume: USD value of tokens swapped through Lunar Finance on the source chain, including meta-aggregator routes (Jupiter, LiFi, 0x, Relay, Orca, etc.) plus Enso batch-sweeper swaps. Data from the Lunar analytics API, filtered per chain and time window.
methodology.Fees: User-paid fees on underlying DEX protocols plus Lunar platform fees where applicable.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Fees collected by the Lunar Finance treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees paid to underlying DEX liquidity providers (total fees minus Lunar protocol revenue).

Fees.Aggregator Fees: Aggregator fees paid by users for the swaps.

UserFees.Aggregator Fees: Aggregator fees paid by users for the swaps.

Revenue.Aggregator Fees to Protocol: Part of the aggregator fees that is retained by the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Aggregator Fees to Protocol: Part of the aggregator fees that is retained by the protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Aggregator Fees to Liquidity Providers: Part of the aggregator fees that is paid to the liquidity providers.

methodology.BridgeVolume: USD value of assets bridged cross-chain through Lunar Finance, attributed to the source chain. Routes use LiFi, Relay, Hyperlane, Stargate, Mayan, and other bridge providers. Data from the Lunar analytics API (confirmed transactions via lunarfinance.io), filtered per source chain and time window.
methodology.Fees: User-paid bridge fees including underlying provider fees.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Fees collected by the Lunar Finance treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees paid to underlying bridge and relayer providers (total fees minus Lunar protocol revenue).

Fees.Bridge Fees: User-paid bridge fees including underlying provider fees.

UserFees.Bridge Fees: User-paid bridge fees including underlying provider fees.

Revenue.Bridge Fees to Protocol: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.

ProtocolRevenue.Bridge Fees to Protocol: Protocol fees retained by Lunar Finance.

SupplySideRevenue.Bridge Fees to Providers: Fees paid to underlying bridge and relayer providers.

methodology.Fees: Fees paid by users to update Pyth price feeds on-chain. Fee amounts per chain are set by Pyth DAO governance via singleUpdateFeeInWei() on each contract.
methodology.Revenue: All update fees accrue to the Pyth protocol treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All update fees accrue to the Pyth protocol treasury.

Fees.Oracle Service Fees: Fees paid by users to update Pyth price feeds on-chain. Fee amounts per chain are set by Pyth DAO governance via singleUpdateFeeInWei() on each contract.

Revenue.Oracle Service Fees To Pyth Treasury: All update fees accrue to the Pyth protocol treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Oracle Service Fees To Pyth Treasury: All update fees accrue to the Pyth protocol treasury.

methodology.Fees: All transaction (gas) fees paid by users on the NEAR blockchain, fetched from Allium.
methodology.Revenue: 70% of every gas fee is permanently burned, reducing NEAR supply. The other 30% is paid to contract developers, so only 70% is protocol revenue.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Burned gas fees (70%) accrue to all NEAR holders through reduced circulating supply.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The remaining 30% of each gas fee is rebated to the developer of the smart contract being called.

Fees.Transaction Fees: All gas fees paid by users on the NEAR blockchain.

HoldersRevenue.Burned NEAR: 70% of gas fees burned, benefiting holders through reduced supply (deflation).

SupplySideRevenue.Smart Contract Developer Rewards: 30% of gas fees rebated to the called contract's developer.
